OPEN ECLASS CHANGELOG
=====================

The complete history of Open eClass (formerly e-Class / GUnet e-Class), from the first commit on
2006-04-13 to 2026-10-08: 111 releases and 20,010 commits.

About this changelog
--------------------

  * Source: it was built from the full version-control history. The git repository mirrors the
    Mercurial repository at https://hg.gunet.gr/openeclass (hg revision 0, "Initial revision" of
    2006-04-13, is the root commit here, and the hg tip matches upstream/master).
  * Releases: from 3.0 onwards, releases are marked by Release_* tags. Before 3.0 there were no
    tags, so the boundaries are the commits that changed the platform version ($langEclassVersion,
    later ECLASS_VERSION).
  * Release lines: 1.6 to 3.2 and 4.0 onwards were released from the default branch. 3.3 to 3.16.4
    came from the 3.x stable branch, which forked after 3.2 (October 2015). 4.3.3 came from a 4.3
    stable branch.
  * Filtering: merge commits are excluded. 3,023 duplicate commits (hg grafts/merges) are listed
    once. 856 commits with no information in the message are omitted. 19,154 commits are listed.

OPEN ECLASS 4.5-DEV (UNRELEASED)  (2026-10-08)
==============================================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2025-08-19 to 2026-10-08. 175 commits (175
listed). Main contributors: ntsagkas (53), Yannis Exidaridis (50), Alexandros Diamantidis (26),
sotavgeris@node-185.noc.uoa.gr (13), mgiannopoulos24 (7), Tasos Sahanidis (7).

Highlights
----------
The current development line (default branch from 28 July 2026; "Default branch is now 4.5-dev"),
not yet released.
  * Programming (code) exercises with a CodeMirror 6 editor and syntax highlighting.
  * New exercise question type file upload, a new oral-question implementation, feedback shown
    according to score, optional blank width in fill-in-the-blanks, stricter exam-mode cancellation,
    and exercise results to PDF.
  * Questionnaires with multiple submissions and a results history, exportable to Excel/PDF overall
    and per user.
  * eduAPI module for synchronising courses and users with an external educational API.
  * Course user analytics pages. Learning analytics fixes.
  * Attendance book spreadsheet import/export in a new format (contributed by T. Sahanidis and M.
    Chatzilazaridis).
  * AI: support for any OpenAI-compatible provider.
  * Swiftmailer replaced with Symfony Mailer. select2 being replaced with SlimSelect. Reports switch
    from mPDF to html2pdf (JS). Upgraded jsTree and jsMind (mind maps rendered with Blade, .jm files
    open in Mindmap).
  * FlowPlayer and flv/swf support removed. Antivirus external tool removed.
  * Multi-course edit with bulk delete and refresh. Select-all checkboxes in documents and
    announcements bulk actions.
  * New themes (Business 4/5, University 4/5, School 4). MathJax in the announcements list.
  * Security: many escaping and XSS fixes, path traversal fixed in sessions, the upload whitelist
    respected when restoring backups, CSRF on API token deletion, and an updated security policy.

OPEN ECLASS 4.4.1  (2026-08-10)
===============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2026-07-20 to 2026-08-10. 18 commits (17 listed).
Main contributors: Alexandros Diamantidis (9), Sotiris Avgeris (5), Yannis Exidaridis (3), ntsagkas
(1).

Highlights
----------
  * PHP 8.2 or later required. Widgets can be enabled or disabled from the admin settings. "My
    grades" is hidden when the user has no active gradebooks.
  * Docker: nginx .php/... path fix and PHP config via environment variables.
  * Gradebook: better handling of decimals, and empty grades are no longer turned into 0.0.

OPEN ECLASS 4.4  (2026-07-20)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2024-12-13 to 2026-07-20. 629 commits (622
listed). Main contributors: plessas (192), Yannis Exidaridis (110), ntsagkas (88), Sotiris Avgeris
(54), Alexandros Diamantidis (52), Nasos Anagnostopoulos (26).

Highlights
----------
  * Multi-tenancy: tenants with their own hierarchy subtree, admins, custom subdomains, platform
    title/intro/contact info, themes and certificate templates, plus usage metrics (users, courses,
    disk usage) and cross-tenant access restrictions. Optional white-label mode.
  * Points games (gamification): points from one-time and recurring activities, levels, leaderboards
    (optionally anonymised), a points-game widget, and notifications on promotion.
  * OpenBadges: connect to backpacks (e.g. Badgr), publish badges with hosted verification, and
    import external badges into the ePortfolio.
  * ePortfolio overhaul: research profile fields (e.g. Scopus), language proficiency (ISO 639-2),
    volunteer activities, per-item visibility levels, reflection comments, personal notes, external
    achievements, a completion percentage, and guest/registered previews. Multilingual ePortfolio
    and custom profile fields.
  * Safe Exam Browser (SEB) support for exercises, enabled globally or per course.
  * Keycloak (OpenID Connect) authentication, with username attribute selection and an SSO logout
    option.
  * External repositories for multimedia and course units (Islandora, DSpace with DC/LOM, Pixabay)
    with rich previews.
  * Sticky notes (Kanban) course module with categories and drag-and-drop.
  * CADMOS / Coby integration: create courses from .cdm learning designs, and log in to Coby via a
    shared secret.
  * New SCORM player with iframe support and Blade templates (the frames-based player was retired).
  * TinyMCE 8 (table, copy/paste, LaTeX icon, resizable editors). select2 4.0.13, SlimSelect, local
    MathJax fonts.
  * Course start/end dates and registration start/end dates. Expired courses hidden from students.
  * Suppressed words filter for the wall and forum. BBB recordings can be fetched and deleted from
    the admin tool. Turnitin frames shown to students after the deadline.
  * Mobile web view improvements and session recovery in the app WebView. API v1: department-based
    access control, SCORM scores, search users by e-mail.
  * Bulk course deletion. Better generated passwords. Badge icons stored in the database. XSS fixes
    in the ePortfolio and profile pages, and a poll file-upload vulnerability fixed.
  * OpenMeetings support removed for good. PHP 8.2 Composer update.

OPEN ECLASS 4.3  (2026-03-17)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2024-09-12 to 2026-03-17. 299 commits (298
listed). Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (86), ntsagkas (72), Thanos Kyritsis (52), Alexandros
Diamantidis (32), Sotiris Avgeris (26), mgiannopoulos24 (12).

Highlights
----------
  * Questionnaires reworked: page breaks, required answers per question, grades per answer and grade
    as a scale, a course evaluation poll template, sub-questions, and new question types (short
    text, datetime, date, file upload). Results can be viewed as charts or tables and per user
    (unless anonymised), with Excel/PDF exports.
  * Certainty-based grading in exercises, plus exercise feedback improvements. The exercise list and
    question list admin rendered with Blade. UI improvement in question creation contributed by
    mgiannopoulos24.
  * Search engine abstraction layer with Apache Solr indexing and querying (Lucene kept as a
    fallback), and admin statistics for the search engine.
  * User theme customisation: users pick from admin-approved themes (stored in a cookie).
  * Import course content into another course. Inactivity (idle) logout detection.
  * UniFlix video support. Public Open Delos links without authentication.
  * TinyMCE: a symbol picker and LaTeX plugin with Greek support. Unit dividers in the course units
    tree.
  * SCORM: "force completed progress" flag for SCOs without progress_measure. Consistent time,
    progress and score in LP reports.
  * Security: path traversal patched, a vulnerable file upload in theme options fixed,
    allowed_classes for unserialize(), parameterised document queries, and .. disallowed in document
    paths.
  * LTI 1.3 as the default, better roles and gradebook services. Mobile API munit method. Course
    user requests include AM and department.
  * C3 0.7.20 / D3 5.16. firebase/php-jwt 7.

OPEN ECLASS 4.2  (2025-12-04)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2025-03-11 to 2025-12-04. 442 commits (439
listed). Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (162), ntsagkas (151), Alexandros Diamantidis (57),
Sotiris Avgeris (37), Thanos Kyritsis (20), dnna (10).

Highlights
----------
  * AI integration: configurable AI providers (with per-course activation) for generating exercise
    questions (including fill-in-the-blanks), asynchronous AI evaluation of free-text answers, and
    an AI course-creation helper that builds a structured syllabus from text, a PDF or a URL.
  * New exercise question types: drag and drop text, drag and drop markers on an image (circles,
    rectangles, polygons), drag and drop onto image, calculated questions (random variables and
    wildcards, Greek letters), ordering, and oral questions (recorded audio answers). All support
    temporary save, statistics and full result exports.
  * Exercises: a QuestionType class hierarchy, an optional grade to pass, stricter exam mode (editor
    restrictions, blur), and strict or tolerant fill-in-the-blanks answers.
  * Per-user course permissions (Permissions class, user permissions table) and pages for accepted
    and rejected course user requests.
  * Printable reports: custom header/footer images, alignment and width for PDF exports.
    Questionnaire results to PDF.
  * Peer review UI reworked. Uppy uploads in assignments. Students can create H5P content (creator
    shown).
  * SCORM: cmi.interactions results and descriptions, cmi.mode, progress_measure, CMITime, and a
    distinct "completed" state.
  * Flipped classroom activities reworked (new course activities and resources).
  * Panopto external tool. API v1 documents endpoint. Solr indexer patch. CSRF checks added in
    exercises, gradebook, attendance, documents and wall.
  * DataTables 2.3.4. The JS build moved to PHP (js/build/build.php), with nothing loaded from
    node_modules. A new "Green" theme. Video tutorials in the manual.
  * colMOOC and Unplag disabled. Password reset links are invalidated after use.

----------

    improvements.

OPEN ECLASS 4.1  (2025-05-08)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2025-02-26 to 2025-05-08. 199 commits (199
listed). Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (87), ntsagkas (54), swtav@sotos (26), Alexandros
Diamantidis (19), Thanos Kyritsis (13).

Highlights
----------
  * LTI 1.3 support (consumer and publisher), including assignments via LTI 1.3 apps with feedback
    release dates.
  * QR codes: attendance check-in by QR code (students can record their own presence) and QR codes
    for questionnaires.
  * Questionnaires: new table-type question, and names hidden from results in student view.
  * Exercise reminders to users who have not submitted.
  * Course units assignable to specific users or groups. Users cannot enter units they are not
    allowed to access.
  * Course setting to allow registration only to users of the course's faculty. Configurable default
    course access type.
  * Notifications reworked (notifications.php, interval configurable by the admin), including
    notifications from course units.
  * Certificates and badges can be added to the user's ePortfolio.
  * Admin monthly and faculty reports reworked, with Excel export.
  * Assignments, e-book viewer, H5P upload, the courses list and the faculties list rendered with
    Blade. opencourses.php renamed to courses.php.
  * neutral became the default theme on new installations. Messages regenerated for de, es, fr and
    it.

OPEN ECLASS 4.0.2  (2025-02-17)
===============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2024-12-13 to 2025-02-17. 134 commits (133
listed). Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (57), sotavgeris (31), Alexandros Diamantidis (25),
ntsagkas (21).

Highlights
----------
  * External tools page redesigned, with categories, filters and icons.
  * Course units redesigned (cards instead of tables, module names, bigger icons, inactive items
    faded).
  * Documents load directories over AJAX and support bulk moves to a chosen directory. Protected
    PDFs show their titles.
  * Home page statistics and intro texts. h5p-standalone 3.8.0 via npm. Many MySQL compatibility
    fixes in SQL queries.
  * The obsolete "send e-mail via mail()" option was removed. Helpdesk e-mail fixes for new
    sign-ups. LDAP e-mail attribute respected.

All changes
-----------

  [UI & theme] (28)
    - 2024-12  System announcements: Consolidate public views (fcd5655d5, Alexandros Diamantidis)
    - 2024-12  Document get source_path after ajax load (5bb79f9c8, sotavgeris)
    - 2024-12  Document ajax load directories (6691a363e, sotavgeris)
    - 2025-01  Footer: small ui improvements (43522c468, ntsagkas)
    - 2025-01  Auth: add missing oauth2 blade file (346477b7c, ntsagkas)
    - 2025-01  Document list: display title if set for protected PDFs (cf29dc0f7, Alexandros

OPEN ECLASS 4.0  (2024-11-21)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2015-05-06 to 2024-11-21. 4,496 commits (4,411
listed). Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (1828), ntsagkas (1003), Alexandros Diamantidis (720),
plessas (213), Thanos Kyritsis (202), nikos vavoulas (185).

Highlights
----------
Open eClass 4.0 was developed on the default branch from October 2015 to its release on 21 November
2024 (4,554 commits). For most of that time, finished features were also backported to the 3.x
stable releases (3.3–3.16) listed further down. The development line includes all of them, plus the
following work that was specific to 4.0.
  * Blade templates and Laravel: the platform moved from the old template engine to Blade views.
    Every admin tool, module and page was "bladed" (2015–2024). Laravel was imported for an API
    layer, and Blade views were later moved to resources/views.
  * The new "modern" UI (Bootstrap 5): a complete redesign merged from the 4.0-gui branch in 2022.
    It brought a new home page (testimonials, carousel, announcements, popular courses), a new
    portfolio with course cards, favourites and notifications, a new course home with view types
    (units, activity, wall, simple, sessions), new breadcrumbs and left menu, offcanvas mobile
    navigation, sticky headers, Font Awesome 6, and the Manrope/Open Sans/Roboto fonts.
  * Theme creation tool: admins design themes component by component (header, footer, forms,
    buttons, cards, tables, agenda, alerts, modals and more, with images, gradients, and boxed or
    fluid layout). It ships with many bundled themes (dark, crimson, emerald, wood, school,
    university, consulting, collaboration, and others).
  * Accessibility: a WCAG-oriented review of forms, labels, ARIA attributes, headings and modals
    across the platform.
  * Widgets: widget areas on the home page, portfolio and course home (HTML, RSS, text), with
    per-user and per-course widgets.
  * ePortfolio: user-defined ePortfolio fields, CV/bio upload, and a resource collection of blog
    posts, assignment submissions and My Documents files, with public sharing by token.
  * Sessions and collaboration platform: a "session"-based course type for consulting and mentoring,
    with session resources, deliverables, completion criteria, prerequisites, attendance, user
    reports, BBB/Zoom links, and a collaboration mode with tutor bookings in groups.
  * Requests module: a ticket-like request tracker with extra fields, watchers and e-mail
    notifications.
  * Platform: maintenance mode, course invitations, quick polls, the course reviewer role, important
    announcements at the top of the screen, a footer/homepage management tool, Force user password
    change, a contact form, Uppy multi-file document uploads with unzip, PDF download prevention for
    documents, and "exam" mode exercises that require login and confine the user to the exercise.
  * Docker support and GitHub Actions builders. Automated installation via environment variables.
    The installer and upgrader rendered with Blade, including a theme-selection step.
  * Removed or replaced: TCPDF (replaced by mPDF), PclZip (ZipArchive), Flowplayer (Video.js),
    WebConf, OpenMeetings, the WAF (phpids), jQuery UI and the old themes.

OPEN ECLASS 3.16  (2024-05-23)
==============================
3.x stable branch. Development period: 2023-12-12 to 2024-05-23. 148 commits (147 listed). Main
contributors: Alexandros Diamantidis (61), Yannis Exidaridis (60), Vaggelis Meimaroglou (14),
sotos@DESKTOP-QVEDL9P (9), Vangelis Meimaroglou (3), dimitris.serpanos (1).

Highlights
----------
  * Zoom API integration (user sync, meeting creation by course editors).
  * OAuth 2.0 login and GUnet Identity (CAS IdP) configuration with Ministry of Education (minedu)
    department mapping.
  * Forbid double logins of the same account (forced logout logged).
  * Exercises: prevent copy/paste, reinstate cancelled attempts, and warnings about questions
    without answers or grades.
  * Documents bulk actions (show/hide, delete, move). The course admin is notified when a course is
    deleted. Rubrics and scales included in backup/restore.
  * Automated installation via environment variables. Clone-course API. Many XSS/escaping fixes
    (e-portfolio, wall filenames, chat, groups, statistics).

OPEN ECLASS 3.15  (2024-01-23)
==============================
3.x stable branch. Development period: 2023-05-17 to 2024-01-23. 208 commits (207 listed). Main
contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (94), Alexandros Diamantidis (74), sotos@DESKTOP-QVEDL9P (30),
Thanos Kyritsis (10).

Highlights
----------
  * Maintenance mode with themes.
  * Quick Poll on the course home. Course reviewer role.
  * Course invitations: course admins invite users by e-mail, with a platform-wide toggle.
  * Microsoft Teams support, plus custom Zoom/Webex URLs per user. External BBB users table.
  * Record audio and video into Documents (RecordRTC).
  * Exercises: Aiken format import. QTI export fixes. Announcements: copy and bulk processing.
  * Progress: learning-path duration criterion, assignment participation, attendance support, and
    completion dates.
  * Learning paths: resume from the previous attempt's suspend_data or start a clean attempt, and
    periodic usage tracking.
  * Admin: add users from an Excel spreadsheet. Users can be barred from unregistering from courses
    or editing name/AM/e-mail. API endpoints to create courses and register many users.

-----------

OPEN ECLASS 3.14  (2023-05-12)
==============================
3.x stable branch. Development period: 2022-11-30 to 2023-05-12. 193 commits (191 listed). Main
contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (112), Alexandros Diamantidis (64), Thanos Kyritsis (17).

Highlights
----------
  * REST API v1 with API tokens (expiry, IP/CIDR restriction): categories, courses, sections, users,
    groups, enrolment, SCORM tracking, SSO.
  * Teleconference services: Google Meet, Jitsi, Zoom and Webex support. WebConf and OpenMeetings
    removed.
  * SCORM API improvements: cmi.score.scaled, adl.nav.request, cmi.exit, and multiple attempts with
    improved reports (xlsx/pdf).
  * XLSX exports (PhpSpreadsheet) for statistics, exercises, gradebook, users and glossary.
    Gradebook import from a spreadsheet template.
  * Exercises: feedback on free-text questions, an end message, and PDF results. Questionnaire
    preview button.
  * Course pages. Option to show the profile image to others. Profile image files get unpredictable
    hashed names.

All changes
-----------

OPEN ECLASS 3.13  (2022-07-07)
==============================
3.x stable branch. Development period: 2021-06-15 to 2022-07-07. 156 commits (154 listed). Main
contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (83), Alexandros Diamantidis (38), dimitris.serpanos (21), Thanos
Kyritsis (11), Vaggelis Meimaroglou (2), serpanos (1).

Highlights
----------
  * Database converted to utf8mb4. Asynchronous, reorganised upgrade process.
  * Flipped classroom course type with study/evaluation activities and unit goals.
  * Course unit prerequisites and completion, with the user's progress per unit on the course home.
  * Favourite courses in the portfolio. Publish a course as an LTI tool (LTI provider with
    cartridge).
  * New exercise question type "fill in from predefined answers". Question pool export to PDF.
  * H5P content enable/disable and reuse/download. MathJax in H5P. UserWay accessibility service as
    an external tool.
  * External DB authentication supports phpass hashes (WordPress-compatible). Admin search for users
    who have not logged in within an interval.

OPEN ECLASS 3.12  (2021-10-26)
==============================
3.x stable branch. Development period: 2021-06-16 to 2021-10-26. 102 commits (100 listed). Main
contributors: Thanos Kyritsis (39), Yannis Exidaridis (33), Alexandros Diamantidis (29), Ziding
Zhang (1).

Highlights
----------
  * H5P: create, edit, view, reuse and delete interactive content, with hub library updates, use as
    a unit resource, and backup/restore.

    departments, plus a "connect as" button.

    resources. PHP 8 compatibility fixes. Warning for PHP < 7.4.

OPEN ECLASS 3.11  (2021-05-25)
==============================
3.x stable branch. Development period: 2021-01-29 to 2021-05-25. 138 commits (136 listed). Main
contributors: Alexandros Diamantidis (69), Yannis Exidaridis (61), Thanos Kyritsis (8).

Highlights
----------
  * One-way exercises (no going back to previous questions). Full and analytical result exports.
    Teachers can change attempt states (paused, incomplete, pending, completed).
  * LimeSurvey questionnaires via LTI, with outcome recording. Polls can allow multiple submissions
    and a default "don't know / no answer" choice.
  * Groups: add multiple members by AM or username. Assignments in DataTables. Assignments not yet
    started are styled differently.
  * BBB load-balancing weights and mic/cam-based methods. Default TC settings for new meetings.
    HackerEarth API v4 for autojudge.
  * index.html placed in course directories to prevent listing on misconfigured servers.

All changes
-----------

  [Exercises] (46)
    - 2021-02  Exercises: change user attempt (incomplete ---> complete or incomplete ---> pending)
      (be1e48f10, Yannis Exidaridis)

      Diamantidis)

OPEN ECLASS 3.10  (2021-01-15)
==============================
3.x stable branch. Development period: 2020-07-22 to 2021-01-15. 143 commits (141 listed). Main
contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (102), Alexandros Diamantidis (30), Thanos Kyritsis (10), George
Miliotis (1).

Highlights
----------
  * Exercises: random questions selected by criteria (difficulty, category, or both), shuffling of
    all or some questions, the user's group shown in results, and course admins can take exercises.
  * Wall course format: a course type built around the wall, with links, exercises, assignments,
    chat, polls and forums posted to it.
  * Statistics: duration per user and per module, and users' last logins.
  * BBB advanced meeting settings, maximum room duration and participants per room (G. Kapetanakis).
  * File-based caching of hierarchy and configuration. A public iCal feed for the personal calendar.
    "Open eClass 2020" themes. TinyMCE 4.9.11. Composer 2 compatibility.

OPEN ECLASS 3.8  (2020-03-23)
=============================
3.x stable branch. Development period: 2019-06-26 to 2020-03-23. 159 commits (157 listed). Main
contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (112), Alexandros Diamantidis (41), Thanos Kyritsis (4),
kola@ceid.upatras.gr (2).

Highlights
----------
  * Learning Analytics module.
  * Peer review for assignments. Assignment grades can be imported from Excel.
  * Forums: threaded or flat view (user preference), file attachments in posts, and topic deletion
    confirmation.

    and cloning images with exercises.

    Awesome 4.7.

OPEN ECLASS 3.7  (2019-04-11)
=============================
3.x stable branch. Development period: 2018-04-20 to 2019-04-11. 114 commits (114 listed). Main
contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (57), Alexandros Diamantidis (40), Thanos Kyritsis (17).

Highlights
----------
  * LTI consumer: LTI tools in courses, including Turnitin via LTI in assignments with grade
    callbacks.
  * colMOOC conversational agent integration in chat.
  * User consent for the privacy policy, recorded per user.
  * The "weekly" course format merged into "units", and units can have start/end dates.
  * Messages: reply to many recipients, forward with attachments, and the original message quoted in
    replies.
  * Exercises: per-user grading of free-text answers, distributing free-text grading among course
    teachers, and saved ordering per attempt.
  * PclZip replaced by ZipArchive throughout. Upgrade from 2.x removed. New-release notice for
    admins. Visible/invisible wikis.

  [Exercises] (23)
    - 2018-10  Exercises: minor fixes (04a8794c6, Yannis Exidaridis)

3.x stable branch. Development period: 2018-03-01 to 2018-05-29. 69 commits (67 listed). Main
contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (44), Alexandros Diamantidis (17), Thanos Kyritsis (8).

Highlights
----------
  * Offline course: download a course as a static HTML package (documents, units, announcements,
    exercises, video, glossary).
  * Course completion and certificates can be purged. External links under active course modules.
    Securimage 3.6.7.

OPEN ECLASS 3.6.1  (2017-12-28)
===============================
3.x stable branch. Development period: 2016-11-01 to 2017-12-28. 410 commits (404 listed). Main
contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (190), Alexandros Diamantidis (159), Thanos Kyritsis (25), Theodore
Schizas (20), mpoufard (9), Panayotis Katsaloulis (3).

Highlights
----------
3.6 was developed through 2017 and released as 3.6.1 in December 2017.
  * Gamification ("progress"): certificates and badges with criteria (documents, exercises,
    assignments, forum, blog, LP, video, course completion and others), certificate templates, and
    course completion shown on the course home and user profile.
  * Rubrics for assignment grading. Plagiarism checking (Unplag/Unicheck, Turnitin placeholders).
  * Toolbox and landing page: configurable home pages (default, external, toolbox) with a
    course-category search ("toolbox") and course categories (activity course type).
  * ePortfolio: a user ePortfolio with a shareable link.
  * Teleconference attendance: BBB participation recorded and pushed into attendance books.
  * Assignments: lock by IP or password, teachers can attach a feedback file, teachers are e-mailed
    on submission, and free-text answers download as PDF (mPDF replaces TCPDF).
  * Exercises: regrading (updates the gradebook), teacher preview, unanswered-question warnings, and
    DataTables pagination for the question pool.
  * Documents: an option for students to upload and manage their own files per course. Mind map can
    be saved to documents as PNG or .jm.
  * Offline course packaging (pre-alpha), never-expiring user accounts, a search for accounts about
    to expire, and Croatian and Portuguese language codes.

OPEN ECLASS 3.3  (2016-02-15)
=============================
3.x stable branch. Development period: 2015-10-22 to 2016-02-15. 280 commits (260 listed). Main
contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (90), Alexandros Diamantidis (85), Theodore Schizas (61), nikos
vavoulas (28), Thanos Kyritsis (8), Ioannis Stais (5).

Highlights
----------
The first release from the 3.x stable branch, forked from the default branch after 3.2 (October
2015). It includes the 3.2.1–3.2.3 maintenance work.
  * E-mail sent through Swift Mailer, with SMTP settings in install, upgrade and admin.
  * Admin statistics: per-faculty statistics with CSV export, old statistics, a system action log,
    and user duration per course.
  * Announcements: status, start/stop datetimes, visibility at creation, and links to admin
    announcements.
  * Platform registration-link/info option. Error 404 page. Warning when JavaScript is disabled.
    Roboto font. WCAG 2.0 fixes on course home, units and logout.
  * Exercises: the session is kept alive every 5 minutes during an attempt, fill-in-blanks fixes for
    [m maths, and new result filters. PHP 7.0 and MySQL 5.7 compatibility fixes.
  * CAS: multiple attributes per field and lower-cased usernames. Better Shibboleth login.

OPEN ECLASS 3.2  (2015-10-22)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2015-03-03 to 2015-10-22. 561 commits (539
listed). Main contributors: nikos vavoulas (121), Alexandros Diamantidis (101), Theodore Schizas
(98), Yannis Exidaridis (92), plessas (63), Thanos Kyritsis (41).

Highlights
----------
  * Custom user profile fields: admin-defined fields and categories (text, textarea, date, menu,
    link) with validation and ordering, used in registration, the profile and admin forms.
  * Social login via HybridAuth (Facebook, Google, Live and others).
  * Mail templates for every system e-mail (registration, verification, password reset,
    announcements, forum, messages, assignments, BBB, and others).
  * Group categories, self-unregistration from groups, member descriptions and comments.
  * Multiple attendance books with start/end dates, gradebook range selection, strict weight
    validation, and AM shown in tables.
  * Security: two-factor authentication (HOTP/QR code), antivirus integration and WAF external
    tools, security-related HTTP headers, and a separate admin login page.
  * Course user requests for closed courses (log_course_user_requests) with teacher replies.
  * Surveys and the wiki open to non-registered users in open courses. Glossary term highlighting.
  * Admin tools: mass move of users and courses between departments, account duration extension, and
    an analytics external tool.
  * Composer introduced (Valitron, HTMLPurifier, phpCAS, PHPass, PclZip). Database checks (InnoDB)
    during install. Much faster search.

All changes
-----------

OPEN ECLASS 3.1.6  (2015-07-24)
===============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2015-01-26 to 2015-07-24. 376 commits (356
listed). Main contributors: Theodore Schizas (83), Alexandros Diamantidis (77), plessas (72), Yannis
Exidaridis (45), nikos vavoulas (34), Panayotis Katsaloulis (23).

Highlights
----------
  * Abuse reports: users can flag comments, forum posts and links, and teachers review and close
    reports.
  * Social bookmarks: user-submitted links inside the Links module.
  * Recycle bin and foreign keys in the database layer. Indirect references and CSRF tokens for
    forms and actions.
  * My Documents: a personal file area. Auto-enrol rules based on department or user attributes.
  * Autojudge: automatic evaluation of programming assignments as an external tool.
  * Grading scales for assignments. Multiple gradebooks with auto-update, cloning and export.
  * Exercises: lock by IP/CIDR (v4 and v6), password protection, multiple paused instances, and
    assignment to specific users or groups (surveys too).
  * Questionnaire results can be shown to participants. Cloud uploads over FTP and WebDAV
    (SabreDAV). OpenCourses visit/hit counts.
  * form_buttons() helper. Hierarchy stored-procedure optimisations.

All changes
-----------

OPEN ECLASS 3.1  (2015-05-29)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2015-03-26 to 2015-05-29. 392 commits (370
listed). Main contributors: Alexandros Diamantidis (113), nikos vavoulas (101), Theodore Schizas
(66), Yannis Exidaridis (42), plessas (34), Thanos Kyritsis (20).

Highlights
----------
  * Personal blogs for users, with comments, ratings and sharing.
  * Module enable/disable at platform level. Tags across modules and course units, independent of
    the course.
  * External Apps framework: BigBlueButton, OpenDelos video bridging, and cloud drives configured as
    external tools.
  * Online-text assignments and assignment start dates.
  * Department managers can create courses and act as course admins and OpenCourses reviewers within
    their jurisdiction.
  * Documents open in a modal viewer, and a "new documents" badge appears in the course menu.
  * Guest login reorganised. CAS and LDAP student ID attributes. Token-protected RSS feeds.
  * Accessibility work: the login page and portfolio reach WCAG AA. Themes are imported from zip
    files, new themes were added, and all CSS was consolidated into one minified SASS build. jQuery
    UI was removed.
  * PHP 5.4 or later is required. Platform use is restricted while an upgrade runs, and the upgrade
    shows a percentage progress bar.

All changes
-----------

    - 2015-04  Grouping theme options / Updating bootstrap to 3.3.4.1 (0b2ad13f0, nikos vavoulas)

OPEN ECLASS 3.0  (2015-04-01)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2011-10-25 to 2015-04-01. 3,621 commits (3,455
listed). Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (709), Theodore Schizas (580), nikos vavoulas (578),
Alexandros Diamantidis (436), Thanos Kyritsis (393), plessas (226).

Highlights
----------
Open eClass 3.0 was a near-total rewrite developed between October 2011 and April 2015 (3,786
commits). It changed the data model, the database layer, the UI and almost every module.
  * Single database: every per-course database (agenda, dropbox, video, forums, exercises, wiki,
    learning paths, questionnaires, assignments) was merged into the main database. Tables and
    fields were renamed to English (cours became course, annonces became announcement, statut became
    status, and so on). InnoDB is the default storage engine, and full-text indexes were dropped.
  * PDO database layer: a new Database object with prepared statements, transactions and typed
    parameters replaced mysql_* and db_query() ("R.I.P. db_query()").
  * Bootstrap-based responsive UI: a new default theme with action_bar()/action_button(), Font
    Awesome icons, Bootstrap modals and date/time pickers, DataTables, select2 and BootBox. The
    classic, modern and ocean themes were removed. The theme options tool sets logos, backgrounds,
    colours, layouts and container width, with import/export. The right sidebar shows courses,
    messages, notifications and quick notes. The UI went through WCAG 2.0 fixes.
  * Hierarchical faculties and departments (tree with multilingual node names, jstree), a Department
    Manager role, and teacher permissions to create courses only in their own department.
  * New modules: Blog, Comments, Ratings (five-star and thumbs up), Social sharing, Notes, Tags,
    Gradebook (multiple per course), Attendance (multiple per course), BigBlueButton
    teleconferencing (multiple servers with load-based selection, recordings imported as video
    links, external participants), and personal, course and admin calendars with recurring events
    and iCalendar export.
  * Messaging: the dropbox was rewritten as a messaging system with inbox and outbox, course and
    personal messages, replies, attachments, recipient autocomplete, group messages, and admin
    broadcast to all users.
  * Exercises: free-text questions graded by the teacher, answers saved per question, temporary save
    and resume, attempt states, detailed results, question categories and difficulty, a filterable
    question pool, mass add of questions by criteria, cloning to other courses, per-exercise and
    per-question statistics, IMS QTI import, multiple answers in fill-in-the-blanks, and tolerant
    matching of answers.
  * Assignments: assignments without a deadline, maximum grade (float grades), assignment to
    specific users or groups, late submissions, an attached file, and a list of students who have
    not submitted.
  * Courses: a weekly course format, course cloning, course images and a description panel,
    per-course settings, course units with public access, polls in units, and restore from 2.x
    backups.
  * Documents: common documents, external files, cloud drive uploads (Google Drive, OneDrive,
    Dropbox), document licences, and a create/edit HTML document option.
  * Search: a Zend Lucene indexer for courses and in-course content (announcements, agenda,
    documents, exercises, forums, links, units, videos) with asynchronous index updates.
  * Learning paths: a new SCORM API with full SCORM 1.2 and SCORM 2004 support, and IMS CP 1.1.4
    export.
  * Forums: ratings on posts, moving topics, replies to specific posts, locked topics, and per-user
    post statistics.
  * Wiki: page revisions with diff and revert, pessimistic page locking, printable view, and group
    wikis.
  * Questionnaires: anonymous questionnaires, a scale question type, statistics, cloning, and CSV
    export.
  * Security and logging: action logging for all modules with log rotation and purging, bcrypt
    (phpass) passwords, an upload whitelist, login-failure limits, password strength and minimum
    length, tokens for password reset and e-mail validation, and IPv6 fixes.
  * Platform: a cron infrastructure (pseudo-cron), the OpenCourses metadata module, an OAI-PMH
    endpoint, the Mobile API, user SSO, Valitron form validation, session flash messages, TCPDF,
    TinyMCE 4, phpCAS 1.3.3, a "Terms of use" page, and a "variable names" pseudo-language for
    translators.
  * Languages moved to lang/<code>/. Swedish was added. The BetaCMS bridge was removed.

OPEN ECLASS 2.9  (2014-03-19)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2014-01-10 to 2014-03-19. 69 commits (65 listed).
Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (31), Alexandros Diamantidis (16), Thanos Kyritsis (14), Yury
Kherimyan (3), yury (3), Costas Tsibanis (1).

Highlights
----------
  * Exercises: attempts are counted from the moment of entry, with a countdown timer in the exercise
    list.
  * New SCORM API ported from 3.0. Learning paths export to IMS CP 1.1.4.
  * External database authentication supports a choice of password hashing.
  * Slovene and Slovak language codes. X-Frame-Options header. jQuery 1.10.2.
  * Alternative logins in the Mobile API.

OPEN ECLASS 2.8  (2013-11-12)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2013-05-09 to 2013-11-12. 154 commits (153
listed). Main contributors: Alexandros Diamantidis (53), Thanos Kyritsis (51), Yannis Exidaridis
(46), Panayotis Katsaloulis (4).

Highlights
----------
  * Open Courses (OpenCourses) metadata: a Course Metadata module backported from 3.0, a Reviewer
    role and reviewer control panel, certification indication on the course home, and listings of
    open courses and faculties.
  * Course licences (Creative Commons): chosen during course creation and on uploaded documents.
  * Course creation reduced to a single step. Online users shown on the home page.
  * Resource access control in video, exercises, course units and documents. Optional password for
    open courses.
  * Dropbox can send messages without files. Exercises are public by default and show pictures in
    results.
  * Multimedia improvements ported from 3.0 (no Flash on iOS). Colorbox 1.4.32.
  * Portuguese language codes. CONFIG_OVERRIDE and MENU_TYPE_ID_OVERRIDE hooks.
  * Old statistics expire after 14 months.

OPEN ECLASS 2.7  (2013-05-08)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2012-10-31 to 2013-05-08. 87 commits (86 listed).
Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (45), Alexandros Diamantidis (37), Thanos Kyritsis (5).

Highlights
----------
  * Common documents: a platform-wide document area managed by the admin (backported from 3.0).
  * Admin tools to create many courses at once and register many users to many courses.
  * Announcement previews stored in the database. Configurable login-failure limits.
  * E-mail to a parent address from the course user list (parent_email).
  * phpCAS 1.3.2, jQuery 1.8.3, TinyMCE 3.5.8. AJAX deletion of profile pictures.
  * HTML Purifier calls moved to input time.

OPEN ECLASS 2.6  (2012-10-31)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2012-09-06 to 2012-10-31. 119 commits (116
listed). Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (64), Alexandros Diamantidis (32), Thanos Kyritsis
(23).

Highlights
----------
  * Upload whitelist: allowed file extensions per user and platform, including the contents of zip
    archives.
  * Brute-force protection: limits on failed logins and lost-password requests.
  * User merge tool and mass deletion of users.
  * AJAX course registration (backported from 3.0) and a password strength indicator.
  * Italian and French translations. Case-insensitive usernames option. enable_search option.
  * Teachers see all dropbox exchanges. Poll results can be exported to CSV.

All changes
-----------

  [Administration] (19)

OPEN ECLASS 2.5.1  (2012-03-16)
===============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2012-01-05 to 2012-03-16. 44 commits (42 listed).
Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (20), Thanos Kyritsis (16), Alexandros Diamantidis (6), Costas
Tsibanis (1), Stevy Georgiadi (1).

Highlights
----------
  * Features backported from the 3.0 branch: TinyMCE 3.4.9 with a custom documents/media picker
    plugin, a Mobile API with a mobile theme, the "my announcements" and "my deadlines" portfolio
    blocks, and SCORM import directly from Documents.
  * UTF-8 detection in zip filenames. Admins can change the verification status of users without an
    e-mail address.
  * Security fix in the agenda.

OPEN ECLASS 2.5  (2012-01-04)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2011-07-21 to 2012-01-04. 240 commits (234
listed). Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (105), Alexandros Diamantidis (77), Thanos Kyritsis
(35), Stevy Georgiadi (13), Tilemachos Raptis (4), stevy (4).

Highlights
----------
  * Power users and user managers: administrators with limited rights over users and courses. Admin
    rights are reset at login.
  * E-mail verification for user accounts (contributed by Y. Kapetanakis), per-course e-mail
    subscription and unsubscription, and no mail sent to unverified addresses.
  * Inactive courses: a new course status visible only to teachers.
  * Exercises: random questions, timestamps, the user's last result shown in the exercise list, and
    deadlines with time of day.
  * Glossary: categories, an alphabetical index, and a maximum number of expanded terms.
  * Multimedia: a Flash video player, modal media viewing (colorbox) and wma support, plus video
    integration in learning paths and course units.
  * New "ocean" theme and new icons for every theme. Print stylesheet.
  * Configuration settings to disable local student or teacher registration and to set the e-mail
    "From" address. The installer now checks register_globals/short_open_tag.
  * Backup and restore: URLs inside course data are translated during restore, and dropbox and
    assignments are restored correctly.
  * Teachers can add multiple users to a course through a form. Tutors can also be ordinary group
    members.

-----------

OPEN ECLASS 2.4.1  (2011-07-21)
===============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2011-06-30 to 2011-07-21. 37 commits (36 listed).
Main contributors: Alexandros Diamantidis (22), Yannis Exidaridis (8), Thanos Kyritsis (5), Costas
Tsibanis (1), Tilemachos Raptis (1).

Highlights
----------
  * Bug-fix release for 2.4.
  * Unified teacher and student registration through alternative authentication methods (CAS and
    Shibboleth), with optional automatic registration of students.
  * New admin tool to change a user's authentication method. Usernames are checked with binary
    collation.
  * Video and video links moved to the main database, including backup and restore.

OPEN ECLASS 2.4  (2011-06-30)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2010-04-27 to 2011-06-30. 1,057 commits (991
listed). Main contributors: Alexandros Diamantidis (377), Yannis Exidaridis (318), Stevy Georgiadi
(154), Thanos Kyritsis (104), Tilemachos Raptis (102), Admin (2).

Highlights
----------
A large release, developed over 14 months (1,500 commits).
  * register_globals=off and short_open_tag=off: every module was ported, so the installer no longer
    requires either setting.
  * Central database: documents, group documents, groups and links moved from per-course databases
    to tables in the main database, with group and course documents unified.
  * TinyMCE editor replaces Xinha. HTML Purifier filters rich text in announcements, course home and
    elsewhere.
  * New tools: an e-book module (HTML e-books from zip uploads, with sections and breadcrumbs), a
    Glossary with automatic term expansion in course texts and CSV export, LOM document metadata
    (XML) editable from Documents, and user profile pictures and descriptions.
  * Authentication: CAS via phpCAS (contributed by TEI of Crete), LDAP patches, Shibboleth teacher
    requests, and an optional CAPTCHA (securimage) on registration. prof_request renamed to
    user_request.
  * Learning paths: a new full-screen viewer with a table of contents and a play button. Blocked
    modules and paths are now enforced.
  * Backup and restore: a new archive format, video files included, selective user restore, internal
    URLs fixed after restore, and ebook directories moved to new IDs.
  * Documents: download a whole directory as a zip file, replace a file in place, and cache
    downloads.
  * Exercises: a new true/false question type, image resizing on upload, and better session handling
    during an attempt.
  * Assignments: group submissions, publishing from group documents, students can retrieve their own
    submissions, and a grade distribution graph.
  * Dropbox: optional e-mail notification to recipients. Forums: user avatars, and the course admin
    can access private group forums and delete topics.
  * Announcements: visibility toggle, a unique URL per announcement, a better RSS feed, and an RSS
    feed on the platform home page. Admin announcements gain ordering and start/end dates.
  * Search: full-text search covers course units and unit resources.
  * Configuration: many settings moved to the config table and became editable from the admin panel
    (email_required, am_required, default quotas, dont_display_login_form, and others). Profile
    fields (phone, e-mail, AM) gain visibility controls.
  * Themes: a new UI with PNG icons, a configurable theme (classic, plus a new modern theme),
    {%var%} template syntax, jQuery and jQuery UI, and the GUnet footer.
  * ?course= became the standard URL parameter for selecting the course.

OPEN ECLASS 2.3.2  (2010-04-27)
===============================

OPEN ECLASS 2.3  (2010-03-18)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2009-12-15 to 2010-03-18. 122 commits (118
listed). Main contributors: Alexandros Diamantidis (65), Yannis Exidaridis (38), Thanos Kyritsis
(12), Tilemachos Raptis (4), Costas Tsibanis (3).

Highlights
----------
  * Course membership moved to a numeric cours_id field (in cours_user and announcements) across the
    whole platform.
  * Forum e-mail notifications (new forum_notify table).
  * BetaCMS bridge: import documents, unit texts and SCORM packages into course units.
  * Wiki pages can be added to course units.

OPEN ECLASS 2.2.1  (2009-12-15)
===============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2009-09-17 to 2009-12-15. 129 commits (124
listed). Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (65), Alexandros Diamantidis (43), Thanos Kyritsis
(21).

Highlights
----------
  * BetaCMS bridge: browse a BetaCMS repository and import lessons, units and SCORM packages into a
    new e-Class course.
  * Shibboleth authentication support.
  * "Student view" lets teachers see the course as a student.
  * Exercises: maths symbols (phpMathPublisher) in descriptions and answers, a score field, and
    question-pool pagination.
  * Deprecated session_register() replaced with $_SESSION. LDAP v3 connections.
  * Course quotas changed, uploads are rejected when over quota, and the upgrade logic now runs
    every upgrade step after the current version.
  * Security: students could register themselves into groups without checks (fixed).

OPEN ECLASS 2.2  (2009-09-17)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2009-05-13 to 2009-09-17. 220 commits (206
listed). Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (97), Alexandros Diamantidis (94), Thanos Kyritsis
(27), Admin (2).

Highlights
----------
  * Course units (thematic sections): a new way to organise a course into units containing
    documents, directories, links, videos, exercises, forums, assignments, learning paths and text.
  * SCORM: support for SCORM_ASSET content, a much improved SCORM API (cmi.interactions,
    lesson_mode, score handling), a table-of-contents frame with progress icons, and better
    compatibility with third-party SCORM packages.
  * Groups: tutors can manage their group's members and properties and e-mail the group, there are
    group usage statistics with date ranges, and each group forum has its own category.
  * Statistics: per-course visit and duration statistics, AM (student ID) and group shown in
    statistics, and CSV export of learning-path and duration results.
  * Exercises: optionally hide correct answers or the score after submission, and students see their
    final results.
  * Administration: multiple user creation with random passwords, phone and AM fields, and an
    editable AM. The block-username-change option.
  * Registration: teacher and student registration unified, and faculties handled by ID (fixing
    names with quotes).
  * Spanish language added. Xinha gains image and font-size buttons. pclzip 2.8.1.
  * ECLASS_VERSION constant introduced.

All changes
-----------

  [Course units] (35)

OPEN ECLASS 2.1.4  (2009-05-13)
===============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2009-03-30 to 2009-05-13. 21 commits (20 listed).
Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (13), Alexandros Diamantidis (8).

Highlights
----------
  * The database version is kept in the config table, which makes upgrades more reliable.
  * Forum topics are paginated, teachers can add assignment comments without a grade, and group work
    submission was fixed.
  * .tar.gz/.tar.bz2 count as a single extension. Greek translation for Xinha's supercleanup plugin.

All changes
-----------

  [Install & upgrade] (5)
    - 2009-04  Better handling of database version during upgrade. Version kept in "config" table.
      (35459b114, Alexandros Diamantidis)
    - 2009-04  restore table cours_faculte (55c4f38c2, Yannis Exidaridis)
    - 2009-04  chnages updated (b4c5fd406, Yannis Exidaridis)
    - 2009-04  δημιουργία του πίνακα config (f851bf4a6, Yannis Exidaridis)
    - 2009-04  added (095b1fb67, Yannis Exidaridis)

OPEN ECLASS 2.1.3  (2009-03-26)
===============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2008-11-14 to 2009-03-26. 73 commits (68 listed).
Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (36), Alexandros Diamantidis (30), Admin (4), Tilemachos Raptis
(3).

Highlights
----------
  * Zip uploads: filenames are converted from CP737 to UTF-8 (with a fallback when iconv lacks
    CP737), and decompressing on upload was fixed.
  * Mail: messages to many recipients are sent via Bcc in batches of 50, with a better To: field for
    announcements.
  * New config table in the database, visibility settings for agenda items, and dropbox file
    encoding.
  * Course admins can unregister themselves if the course has another admin. The platform admin can
    browse all courses without registering.
  * New DejaVu fonts for statistics and more MIME types (ppt, xls, pps, wmv).

OPEN ECLASS 2.1  (2008-09-08)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2007-05-02 to 2008-09-08. 748 commits (636
listed). Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (379), Tilemachos Raptis (137), Alexandros Diamantidis
(112), Evelthon Prodromou (71), Thanos Kyritsis (21), Costas Tsibanis (11).

Highlights
----------
A modernisation release. Its main changes were the switch to UTF-8 and one-way password hashing.
During this cycle the product name moved from "e-Class" to "eClass" (May 2008).
  * UTF-8 everywhere: configuration files, databases and messages were converted from ISO-8859-7 to
    UTF-8, and the upgrade converts existing installations.
  * Security: passwords are stored with one-way hashing, there is a new password-reset tool, and
    unauthorised assignment downloads and link management are blocked.
  * Xinha WYSIWYG editor: replaces htmlarea in announcements, agenda, assignments, course
    descriptions and course creation.
  * Maths: phpMathPublisher formulas in announcements, agenda and course descriptions.
  * Questionnaires: the poll module was rewritten, and surveys and polls were merged into one
    Questionnaire module.
  * Registration: students can register through a request form, teacher accounts can be created
    through alternative authentication methods (fields pre-filled from LDAP), the registration form
    keeps its values on error, and the administrator can close user registration.
  * Administration: a "clean up old files" tool, student requests, statistics generated in
    courses/temp, and a jscalendar date picker.
  * Installer: bilingual installer, a max_execution_time check, the video directory and course temp
    directories created during install/upgrade, and the configuration backed up before upgrade.
  * Documents and video: directories and files are stored under encoded names on the filesystem
    (non-ASCII names supported), video is streamed inline, and group documents are upgraded too.
  * UI: centralised language selection, a refreshed logo and favicon, IE6 fixes, a new copyright
    footer, and English manuals.

OPEN ECLASS 2.0  (2007-05-02)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2006-04-17 to 2007-05-02. 1,205 commits (1,080
listed). Main contributors: Evelthon Prodromou (392), Yannis Exidaridis (236), Dionysios G.
Synodinos (124), Thanos Kyritsis (100), Stratos Karatzidis (94), Sakis Agorastos (67).

Highlights
----------
The 2.0 rewrite: a new template engine and UI across the whole platform, plus a large set of new
tools.
  * New template engine and UI ("baseTheme"): every module was ported to the new template, with a
    new icon set, CSS, breadcrumbs, left-hand tool menu, and open-source Greek fonts.
  * "eClass personalised" portal: a per-user start page with lessons, announcements, assignments,
    agenda, forum and document blocks.
  * Learning paths: the module was ported from e-Class 1.6, with SCORM 1.2 and SCORM 2004
    import/export, tracking and progress reporting, and support for documents, links, exercises and
    course descriptions.
  * New tools: platform and course usage statistics with charts (libchart), surveys (COLLES/ATTL
    templates) and polls, platform full-text search, a tool-management module for course tools,
    admin announcements, and the first Wiki module (April 2007).
  * Authentication: pluggable authentication methods (LDAP, POP3, IMAP and others) managed by the
    administrator, encrypted passwords in the database, and guest accounts with expiry dates.
  * Administration: a new admin dashboard, user search and editing, course quotas, activation of
    inactive accounts, a list of administrators, and platform upgrades from the admin panel.
  * Installation: a new installation wizard with a requirements check (mbstring now required, GD
    optional).
  * Course features: course passwords and access types, a new three-step course-creation wizard,
    course backup links, and a new file manager with document metadata.
  * Forums: phpBB integration reduced to what e-Class 2.0 needs.
  * Security: many hardening fixes, including input validation, guest and professor access checks,
    register_globals=off compatibility, and XSS escaping.

All changes
-----------

OPEN ECLASS 1.6  (2006-04-13)
=============================
Default (development) branch. Development period: 2006-04-13 to 2006-04-13. 1 commit (0 listed).
Main contributors: Yannis Exidaridis (1).

Highlights
----------
Initial import of the e-Class 1.6 code base into version control (13 April 2006), the starting point
of the 2.0 rewrite.
